subject: Request: extended credits for security-locked VPC POC
messages:
From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@healthgrid.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended credits for VPC POC (security review blocking)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We're excited about Redwood's dedicated VPC option but we've hit a gating issue on our side: the security review requires us to run a full in-scope pass (including pen test + data residency checks) inside an isolated environment before we can approve the production pilot. That evaluation will consume more GPU hours than our current trial covers.

Can Redwood provide a short bridge — either additional trial credits or a temporary prepaid credit allotment — so we can complete the security tests? Rough scope attached (HealthGrid-PoC-scope.pdf). Ideal ask: an extra 60 days and a $10k credit pool, or a GPU-hour equivalent, whichever you prefer to offer for the POC.

Constraints to note:
- No external egress during the test window (we need IP allowlist + outbound controls).
- Audit log access for a 30-day window after the run.
- We will provide a SOC2 snapshot and a summary of the sensitive fields we plan to ingest.

If you can confirm the process/guardrails (and any evidence Redwood needs from us), I'll coordinate procurement. Appreciate quick turnaround — security wants this done week of Apr 19.

Best,
Alex Martin
Head of Integrations, HealthGrid.ai
A: Alex Martin
Attachments: HealthGrid-PoC-scope.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended credits for VPC POC (security review blocking)

Alex — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Ben (security) and Karthik (SE) so we can confirm the compliance guards and a credit sizing. Marissa from Commercial is on copy for any billing/contract hoops.

Two quick clarifying Qs for our side:
1) Will HealthGrid run synthetic data only for the pen test, or will you use a small slice of production data?
2) Do you have a preferred MOU shape for the temporary credits (we typically do a short amendment that ties credits to evidence milestones).

We are often able to approve a temporary credit allocation tied to evidence and a signed MOU. I need internal approvals but if Ben and Karthik can confirm the technical and risk posture, I should be able to commit a pilot bridge (duration & amount TBD).

I'll put a proposal in thread by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martin <alex.martin@healthgrid.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended credits for VPC POC (security review blocking)

Rachel / Team — quick read from security: we can support a conditional credit release but need the following before we move to the second tranche:

1) A redacted SOC2 snapshot (controls mapping for in-scope systems) — fine to redact customer names, but it must show the control set and attestation date.
2) An IP allowlist for the Redwood VPC endpoints and confirmation you will not permit outbound internet access during the test window (we can enforce via network policies).
3) A short MOU that includes: scope of test, data residency constraints, audit log retention (30 days minimum), and acceptance criteria for moving to production.

Proposed release pattern:
- Initial sandbox credit: $2,000 to provision dedicated nodes and run onboarding/smoke tests.
- Secondary release: $6,000 released after receipt of SOC2 snapshot + signed MOU and confirmation of allowlist.
- We will instrument log forwarding (read-only) for the audit window; logs to be stored in a customer-controlled S3 if required.

We will not accept full production traffic under this arrangement; this is strictly for security validation. If HealthGrid wants a different cadence, propose it here.

Ben Carter
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-template.pdf (template)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martin <alex.martin@healthgrid.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended credits for VPC POC (security review blocking)

On Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 11:20 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed release pattern:
> - Initial sandbox credit: $2,000 ...
> - Secondary release: $6,000 ...

Thanks — technical notes on sizing and ops:
- The HealthGrid scope looks like ~18 hours of heavy GPU runs (quantized LLM + rerank) and ~120k tokens of ingestion/embedding for schema validation.
- Our rough mapping: $2,000 initial credit will cover node reservation + 6–8 hours of testing for onboarding. $8,000 total is a reasonable bridge for the full test (matches Ben's split).
- Because this is a private/VPC setup we need a short maintenance window to provision dedicated nodes (48–72 hours). Please confirm preferred start window.
- I can run a technical onboarding session (30–45 mins) with HealthGrid's infra/security team the day the environment is provisioned.

If HealthGrid confirms a 60-day test window and signs the short MOU, we can schedule provisioning for Apr 21 and have the environment ready by Apr 24.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@healthgrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended credits for VPC POC (security review blocking)

Alex — quick update and approval steps. Based on the scope and security ask, Commercial has authorized a bridge of $8,000 in credits with these conditions:

1) 60-day extension of the POC window starting on the provisioning date.
2) Initial $2,000 credit applied at provisioning to cover node reservation and onboarding smoke tests.
3) Remaining $6,000 released after Redwood receives: the redacted SOC2 snapshot (SOC2-redacted-snapshot.pdf) and a signed MOU (attached draft: POC-MOU-draft.docx).
4) Confirmed IP allowlist for Redwood endpoints and agreement to the outbound-egress block during the test.

Marissa — please issue the credit memo and route the MOU (DocuSign link below) to HealthGrid for signature.

Alex — please upload the SOC2 snapshot and sign the MOU at: https://app.docusign.com/POC-MOU-HG so we can release the second tranche quickly. Karthik will schedule provisioning for Apr 24 once we get your confirmation on start date.

If anything in the MOU is a blocker, flag here and we'll accelerate redlines.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC-MOU-draft.docx, SOC2-redacted-snapshot.pdf
